purpose: Backbone freeze before held-out CARB external evaluation
selection_basis: Retained after prior development-stage comparisons; CARB is excluded from backbone selection and tuning.
holdout_policy: Do not change the verifier backbone based on CARB outcomes. Any later model change constitutes a new experimental configuration and must not replace this CARB run retrospectively.
note: This file freezes the semantic backbone only. The final experiment manifest must additionally record the final architecture/code commit, Ollama digest, prompts, rubric, retrieval settings, and runtime hashes.
